subject: Pilot planning: confirm deep-dive time & loop in security + procurement
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophia Nguyen <sophia.nguyen@aurelialabs.com>, Kevin James <kevin.james@aurelialabs.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot planning: confirm deep-dive time & loop in security + procurement

Hi Sophia / Kevin —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Aurelia is evaluating a short pilot to validate low-latency embeddings and reranking for search, plus an integration pattern for your private VPC deployment. Next logical step is a focused technical deep-dive (45–60m) where Marissa can walk through an environment plan and we can scope data/procurement checkpoints.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 7 Dec, 10:00–11:00 or 11:30–12:30
- Wed 8 Dec, 14:00–15:00

Can you confirm which window works? If neither, send 2 windows that fit your calendar and we’ll accommodate.

A few asks so we can make the session productive:
- Please add your procurement contact (Kevin?) and your security lead so we can cover evidence and retention expectations.
- If you have any pre-existing security checklist, drop it in reply (we can review ahead of the call).
- If possible, share a test account or sample slice of anonymized data (S3 link) so Marissa can tailor the demo.

I’ve attached a short pilot agenda for the deep-dive and a link to a mutual action plan draft — we can edit during the call: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDefMutualActionPlan

Attachments: pilot-agenda.pdf (one-pager)

Thanks — I’ll loop in our security lead and SE once you confirm.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Sophia Nguyen <sophia.nguyen@aurelialabs.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@aurelwdinference.com>
Cc: Kevin James <kevin.james@aurelialabs.com>, procurement@aurelialabs.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot planning: confirm deep-dive time & loop in security + procurement

Vanessa —

Appreciate the recap and the agenda. We’re excited to see how Redwood handles embeddings latency at our scale. My security lead is out until Friday, but Kevin (cc) is covering procurement. We do need a brief security intro on the call — specifically: data retention, audit logs, and VPC tenancy model.

Of the proposed slots, the team prefers Tue 7 Dec at 10:00 PT. If that works for you, please send an invite.

Attached: Aurelia-Security-Reqs.xlsx — it’s our internal checklist, FYI.

Also: procurement would like an estimate of monthly token units for a 50K query pilot and any required contract terms (standard MSA + SOC2 addendum). Not necessary to finalize on the call but helpful to have ballpark numbers.

Thanks,
Sophia
Head of Product | Aurelia Labs
sophia.nguyen@aurelialabs.com

Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot planning: confirm deep-dive time & loop in security + procurement

Thanks, Sophia — Tue 7 Dec at 10:00 PT works great. I’m looping in Markus (security lead) and Marissa (SE) so we can cover evidence and demo flow.

Markus / Marissa — please see Sophia’s checklist attached. High level asks for the session:
- Cover architecture for private deployment (VPC, data at rest / in transit) — Markus
- Run a short end-to-end demo with a sample query slice (we’ll use anonymized S3) — Marissa
- Provide a ballpark monthly token estimate for a 50K query pilot and outline contracting steps — Vanessa / Karthik can handle pricing/terms

Deliverables before the call:
- Markus: SOC2 exec summary + notes on audit log retention (SOC2-exec-summary.pdf)
- Marissa: tailored demo env checklist and test-data handling notes
- Vanessa: mutual action plan link + HubSpot deal updated (RDW-3679)

Sophia / Kevin — I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue 7 Dec, 10:00–11:00 PT with a short agenda and dial-in. If there’s anyone else on your side (security or infra) who should join, please add them.

— Vanessa

Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot planning: confirm deep-dive time & loop in security + procurement

Thanks Vanessa — I’ll be on the call Tue 7 Dec at 10:00 PT. I attached a short SOC2 executive summary and a note on audit-log retention to share in advance.

Quick notes I’ll cover during the session:
- Redwood private deployment options: VPC peering vs. dedicated tenancy and trade-offs for auditability
- What we store (KV cache, ephemeral logs), how long by default, and configurable retention windows
- Audit log formats, SIEM forwarding options, and support for customer-managed KMS

If Sophia’s team can share the S3 test bucket link ahead of time, I’ll pre-validate least-privilege access patterns.

Attachment: SOC2-exec-summary.pdf

— Markus Klein
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
